name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's culinary journey began in his grandmother's bustling Seoul restaurant, where he learned the importance of flavor, presentation, and efficiency. After graduating from culinary school, Jae-hyun worked in several high-end restaurants, honing his management skills and developing a passion for creating exceptional dining experiences. His love for motorsport was ignited during a visit to a local race, and he saw an opportunity to combine his culinary expertise with his newfound passion.

Joining Ipiranga Racing was a dream come true for Jae-hyun. He approaches his role as catering manager with meticulous planning and a dedication to providing nutritious and delicious meals for the entire team. He understands the importance of catering to individual dietary needs and preferences, ensuring that everyone is fueled and focused. Jae-hyun's demanding nature pushes his team to deliver consistently high-quality service, making him a vital part of the Ipiranga Racing family. His unique approach involves incorporating traditional Korean flavors with modern techniques, resulting in a distinctive and memorable dining experience for the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze and a warm smile.

quirks: Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even if it means going to several different markets.
Has a habit of meticulously arranging food displays, often spending excessive time on presentation.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipes or ideas that come to him.
